name: WF-236 — Offer Delivery Receipt → Seller Response / Timeout Controller

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const receipt=String(d.delivery_status??d.receipt_status??"").toLowerCase();const response=String(d.seller_response_status??"").toLowerCase();const dispatch_id=d.dispatch_id??null;let state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Offer delivery state is invalid or incomplete.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id||!dispatch_id){reason="Missing offer dispatch identity.";}else if(["delivered","delivery_confirmed"].includes(receipt)){if(["received","response_received","replied"].includes(response)){state="response_received";route="WF-237";reason="Offer was delivered and a seller response is available.";}else if(["timeout","expired","no_response"].includes(response)){state="response_timeout";route="WF-238";reason="Offer was delivered but the seller response window expired.";}else{state="awaiting_seller_response";route="WF-238";reason="Offer delivery is confirmed and the system is awaiting seller response.";}}else if(["failed","undelivered","bounced"].includes(receipt)){state="delivery_failed";route="WF-235";reason="Offer delivery failed and requires safe retry/recovery.";}else if(["pending","queued","sent",""].includes(receipt)){state="receipt_pending";route="WF-235";reason="Delivery receipt is not yet confirmed.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-236",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,dispatch_id,delivery_status:receipt,seller_response_status:response,state,route,reason,delivery_reconciliation:{receipt_required:true,delivery_confirmed:["delivered","delivery_confirmed"].includes(receipt),response_available:["received","response_received","replied"].includes(response)},requires_human_review:state==="delivery_failed"||state==="blocked"}}];
